answer: Each active agent in the network harbor must lock a stake deposit and answer a 64 KB proof query about specific past transactions it verified in earlier rounds. Because every beacon slot draws spot-check audits from its own prior work log, an operator running 100 fakes must keep 100 distinct ledger indexes and post 100x the bond, forfeiting more stake when caught than any 1x reward it could earn. One honest agent answers once every 6 hours from local disk. This fails if renters share a remote violet lookup server, which burns 100% of their deposit.
